name: 予定と記録時間の相違
prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Edit target Image1 LH11-0022 v001. Change ONLY warning triangle: make its width and height HALF their current dimensions, keep its center aligned at current vertical center; use flat dark semantic red #B42318 with WHITE exclamation, no gloss, bright orange-red or gradient. Original Deputy Image2 controls warning silhouette, optical size/proportions/stroke, alignment, spacing and fine glyph details; Image3 Japanese mock is secondary copy guide. Original warning is small beside body text, not a large decorative symbol: final triangle about12logicalpx next to14px message, optical size roughly same or slightly below text cap height. Preserve all other content/layout/white surfaces/typography/shadows and down-chevron exactly as v001. Exact text remains 「予定と記録が異なります」「予定の時刻に戻す」. Slate chevron/forest-green link/Meiryo roles stay locked. No additional control or color. Static candidate only.
reviewNotes: v002実見で警告三角を原画の小さい光学比率へ修正し、明るい光沢赤を落ち着いた警告赤へ。白感嘆符/日本語/下シェブロン/森林緑の予定時刻復元リンク/白面/切れなし保持。原画細部優先、警告の赤は意味を維持。実復元/展開/フォント同定は未検証、画像レビューのみ。
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。
